title: EDC Los Angeles 09
description:
I went to L.A. to meet up with some old and new friends to enjoy Electric Daisy Carnival 2009 which was 2 days and one  of the sickest line-ups.
The videos and pictures dont do justice to what we went thru but it'll give you an idea.
Contact me with your e-mail so i can send you raw footage of anybody in particular.
and i apologize to those who werent included in the video, i didnt get to shoot footage of everyone this year.
